parsed.post: My last experiment (MATRIX_LR 0.05, WARMUP_RATIO 0.1) reduced val_bpb to 1.040453. Keeping this. Next, I'll experiment with reducing the TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase the number of optimizer steps within our 5-minute budget, which seems to be a winning strategy for others.
parsed.description: Reducing batch size to increase the number of optimizer steps within the fixed 5-minute training budget.
